scripts.dev: concurrently -n tts,server,client -c magenta,blue,green "npm run tts" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:no-tts: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.tts: cd tts-service && uv run python -m apps.openai_speech
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
